headline: Indian IT services showed uneven growth in Q2 FY27, with AI‑driven firms outpacing slower‑growing peers.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low‑single digits to over 50% YoY. AI revenue was highlighted by several firms and helped lift margins at HCLTech and TCS. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys and introduced at HCLTech, indicating cautious outlook. Profit trends were mixed, with some firms posting double‑digit profit growth while others saw declines.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Companies such as HCLTech, TCS and Mphasis reported strong AI contributions, boosting profit and margin expansion.

themes.title: Divergent growth rates
themes.detail: Coforge posted 53.6% YoY revenue growth, while Infosys and Wipro grew under 2% YoY, reflecting a split between high‑growth and mature players.

themes.title: Margin pressure at larger peers
themes.detail: Despite revenue growth, firms like Infosys and Wipro saw operating margins under 22%, lower than high‑growth peers.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
11.5% YoY revenue growth, 21% profit jump and $219 m AI revenue.

laggards.why: Revenue growth trimmed to 1‑2% and profit growth slowed to 6% YoY.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and margins slipped.
